source_pr.title: Add DeleteBlock to IndexCache interface for block-level cache invalidation

blast_radius_note: All concrete IndexCache implementations must add DeleteBlock: pkg/storage/tsdb/indexcache/inmemory.go (InMemoryIndexCache), pkg/storage/tsdb/indexcache/remote.go (RemoteIndexCache), pkg/storage/tsdb/indexcache/tracing.go (TracingIndexCache). Additionally any test fakes or mock types implementing IndexCache across pkg/storegateway/ would break. The interface is also used at call sites in pkg/storegateway/bucket.go and pkg/storegateway/bucket_stores.go which may hold the interface as a field or parameter type.
